library.title: Library
library.emptyTitle: Start with a folder of photos
library.emptyBody: JPEG, PNG and HEIC. Everything stays on this computer.
library.refreshHint: Look for photos added to these folders since; your edits are kept
library.removeFolderHint: Remove from the library (the files stay on disk)
library.folderHint: Show only this folder; drag to reorder (Alt+↑ ↓)
library.selectHint: Select several folders to show or export together (or Ctrl/⌘-click)
library.basketHint: The photos you will print: ↑ in the preview, or Select in the gallery
library.asideHint: Photos you put aside with ↓: out of the gallery, never deleted; open them to decide again
library.placeBorrowed: Place borrowed from a phone photo
library.fromXmp_one: Stars or reject from {{count}} XMP sidecar (Lightroom, Bridge…)
library.fromXmp_other: Stars or rejects from {{count}} XMP sidecars (Lightroom, Bridge…)
library.unusual: Unusual file: see the inspector for what it is

culling.keysHint: 0–5 stars · P pick · X reject · U unflag · [ ] rotate
culling.filtersHint: Flags, stars, RAW or not: the gallery and the export show what they keep

bestShot.findHint: Groups bursts and similar shots, then suggests the best of each: sharpest, eyes open, no shake, good exposure. Nothing changes until you choose Keep best.
bestShot.emptyBody: Find best shots looks for bursts and near-identical photos and suggests the best one of each group. Nothing is rejected until you confirm.
bestShot.noneFound: No similar shots found among {{count}} photos.
bestShot.tooCloseHint: These shots score almost the same. Choose the one you like.
bestShot.keepBestHint: Picks the best photo; it stays in the Workspace. The others are rejected and go to Set aside, ready to come back. Nothing is deleted; undo with Cmd/Ctrl+Z.
bestShot.chooseHint: Too close to call: compare and choose one.
bestShot.keepAllHint: Does Keep best in every group that is not too close to call: each best shot stays in the Workspace, the others go to Set aside.
bestShot.where: Keep best: the best shot stays in the Workspace, the others go to Set aside.

settings.title: Print settings
settings.printSizeHint: Centred by default. Adjust per photo with Crop in the preview.
settings.borderHint: A white or black border 3 mm wide inside the print size, cut into the photo: the print stays the exact kiosk size. With the info frame, the border takes the frame’s colour, and Fit whole photo fits inside the size instead of growing.
settings.borderHintPaper: A 3 mm border round each photo, cut into it. White or black is also the colour of the paper round the photos.
settings.locationTip: Offline place names arrive in a later slice (FR-005)
settings.locationHint: From the photo's GPS, at town level, offline.
settings.caption: Line under the date
settings.captionHint: Printed in capitals without accents, across the photo.
settings.resetCustomStamps_one: Reset {{count}} photo with its own stamp
settings.resetCustomStamps_other: Reset {{count}} photos with their own stamp

print.errorRange: Edges must be between 2 and 100 cm

fonts.removeTitle: Remove this font (photos fall back to Inter)

frame.title: Info frame
frame.cropHint: The print keeps its size; drag the photo in the preview to choose what stays.
frame.fitHint: The whole photo at the print size, framed like an instax print: a 5 mm border on three sides and the bar below, so the print is larger than the chosen size.
frame.fitSize: Fit whole photo: this print comes out about {{size}}: the photo at the print size, plus a 5 mm border on three sides and the info bar. Choose a paper that fits at the print shop.
frame.keepsSize: The whole print, frame included, keeps the selected size.
frame.editInPreview: Edit camera, lens and style in the preview.
frame.logoSizeHint: The same for every photo. Double-click for 100 %.

camera.noInfo: No camera information in this photo.
camera.name: Camera name
camera.fromExif: From EXIF: {{shutter}} · {{iso}}. Leave a field empty to use EXIF. Saved for every photo from this camera.

export.larger: {{from}} → {{to}}: print files keep every detail, so they can be larger than the originals
export.title: Export
export.filteredHint: Only the photos the library filter shows are exported.

fill.label: Whole photo in a frame
fill.hint: Each photo stays whole, centred in a frame of the ratio, the rest filled: a portrait on a square feed, nothing cut off.

presetHint.original: Same pixels, about half the file size or less · sRGB · camera details kept, GPS removed
presetHint.facebook: Facebook's best size, so it is not resized again · sRGB · camera details kept, GPS removed
presetHint.instagram: 1080 px wide, portraits up to 3:4 · sRGB · camera details kept, GPS removed
presetHint.custom: 640–6000 px on the long edge · sRGB · camera details kept, GPS removed

folders.label: How the folders are exported
folders.separateHint_one: {{count}} folder, each in a subfolder with its name
folders.separateHint_other: {{count}} folders, each in a subfolder with its name

days.label: Where the files go
days.oneFolderHint: Every photo straight into the folder you choose
days.byDayHint: A folder for each day, such as 2026-07-14

crop.straightenHint: Level the horizon, ±15°: ← → by 1°, ⌥ ← → by 0.1°. Double-click to reset.

viewer.cropFitMode: The frame is in Fit mode: the whole photo is shown
viewer.noExifDate: No EXIF date · using file time
viewer.allPhotos: Print settings apply to all photos for now.
viewer.zoomPinch: or scroll up or down with two fingers, pinch, or double-click the photo
viewer.syncClock: Set this camera's clock from a photo…
viewer.exportHint: Export this photo: its card at the foot of the panel (⇧ {{mod}} E)
viewer.keys:
← →  browse · ↑ to the print basket · ↓ set aside
0–5 stars · P pick · X reject · U clear the flag
R or C crop · [ ] or {{mod}} [ ] rotate
Z, or a click on the photo: fit ↔ 1:1 · {{mod}} + − 0 zoom · drag to move the zoomed photo
J clipping · W white balance from a grey spot · \ before / after · Y side by side · ⇧Y split · ⌥/Alt Y top and bottom
{{mod}} Z undo · ⇧ {{mod}} Z redo
⇧ {{mod}} C copy settings · ⇧ {{mod}} V paste · ⌥ ⇧ {{mod}} V paste to the ticked photos · ⇧ {{mod}} R reset
F fill the app window or back · Tab hide the side panels (from the photo)
⇧ {{mod}} E export this photo · Esc close
viewer.sideFolded: A narrow window shows one side column: widen it to see the histogram, the Navigator and History on the left too.
viewer.pickWhite: Click something in the photo that should be neutral grey: its warmth and tint follow. Esc cancels.
viewer.sideShow: Show the left column: histogram, Navigator, History (Tab)

camera.failed: The camera stopped answering. Check the cable
camera.refused: The camera refused. Check that it is in PC Remote mode

camera.save_failed: The photos could not be moved. Check the destination folder and try again
camera.delete_failed: The photos could not be deleted

camera.destination_open: That folder is already a tab: choose another one
camera.not_session: This folder is not a camera session
camera.not_imported: The shot was saved in the session folder but could not be added to the tab

decode.truncated: The file ends before the photo does: it may have been copied only in part

import.unsupported: This format is not supported yet

import.raw_codec_missing: This camera's RAW files can't be read yet. Microsoft's free "Raw Image Extension" may open them
import.heic_linux: HEIC photos are not supported on Linux yet: convert them to JPEG, or open them on macOS or Windows

logo.decode_failed: The logo could not be decoded
logo.not_png: The logo must be a PNG file
logo.too_large: The logo is larger than 2 MB or 4096 px
logo.unreadable: The logo file could not be read
logo.write_failed: The logo could not be saved

postcard.no_text: This postcard has no text to use

photo.nothing_copied: Copy settings from a photo first

look.full: You already keep 1,000 looks: remove some first
look.unknown: This look is no longer in your list
look.lut_too_large: The LUT is larger than 8 MB
look.lut_invalid: This LUT file cannot be read
look.lut_unreadable: The LUT file could not be opened or kept
look.preset_too_large: The preset file is too large
look.preset_empty: This preset changes nothing a look can hold

project.not_a_project: This is not a Fotollection project
project.newer_version: This project was saved by a newer version of Fotollection
project.too_large: The project file is too large
project.write_failed: The project could not be saved
project.invalid_name: Use a name without / \\ : * ? " < > | (up to 120 characters)
project.name_taken: A file with this name already exists in the folder
project.rename_failed: The project could not be renamed

culling.empty: There are no photos to analyse
culling.unknown_group: This group is out of date. Run Find best shots again.
culling.model_failed: The face model could not run
culling.analysis_failed: A photo could not be analysed

update.offline: Could not reach GitHub. Check your internet connection and try again.
update.unreadable: GitHub's answer could not be read. Try again later.

history.unknown_step: This step is no longer in the photo's history

project.newBody: Give it a name. The photos and folders you have now are closed; save them first if you want to keep them.
project.unsavedBody: Your changes will be lost if you don't save them.
project.relinkBody: The photos were moved or renamed after the project was saved. Locate each folder to bring back its edits.
project.title: Project

advice.summary: the original is {{width}} × {{height}} px ({{mp}} MP). It prints sharp up to about {{sharp}} and is still acceptable up to {{acceptable}}.

about.report: Report a problem or an idea
about.reportHint: Opens the project's page on GitHub in your browser. Paste the diagnostics there: the version, the system and the last error codes, without paths or photos. The app sends nothing itself.

update.replaces: Install it over this version: it replaces the app and keeps your settings and projects.
update.privacy: Click to look now; the app also looks once at start unless that is turned off above.
update.popupBody: You have {{current}}. Nothing is downloaded until you choose.
update.atStart: Check for updates when the app starts
update.atStartHint: One request to GitHub at start; nothing about you or your photos is sent, and nothing is downloaded by itself.

cache.clearHint: Deletes thumbnails, previews and best-shot analyses; they are made again when needed
cache.note: Thumbnails, previews and analyses only. The oldest go by themselves past the limit; your photos and projects are never touched.
cache.title: Cache on disk
cache.limitHint: A larger cache keeps the previews of more folders, so they open at once next time too, at about 0.7 MB a photo. Past the limit, the oldest go first.
cache.prepareHint: Any photo then opens in about 30 ms instead of 0.3 to 0.5 s. Off saves disk space: previews are made when a photo is opened.

estimate.larger: Estimated: {{from}} → {{to}}; print files keep every detail, so they can be larger

select.hint: Tick photos for the print basket or to set aside; hold Space over a photo to look at it
select.quickHint: Enter to select · ← → next · release Space to close

preview.basketHint: Add to or remove from the print basket (↑)
preview.toGalleryHint: Bring this photo back to the gallery

cameras.title: Camera clocks
cameras.hint: A camera set to the wrong time puts its photos in the wrong place. Type how much to add, like +1:02:00 or −0:45; every photo from that camera moves, and the time it wrote stays in the photo.
cameras.matchTitle: Set the clock of {{camera}} from a photo
cameras.matchBody: Pick the photo from your phone or another camera that was taken at the same moment as this one. Fotollection works out how far off this camera's clock is.
cameras.matchNone: No photo from another camera or phone within a day of this one.
cameras.matchResult_one: {{camera}} will be corrected by {{offset}}; its {{count}} photo moves.
cameras.matchResult_other: {{camera}} will be corrected by {{offset}}; its {{count}} photos move.

capture.connectHint: Shoot from a camera plugged in by cable: live view, Capture, and the photos in a new tab
capture.windowsOnly: Connecting a camera works on Windows for now; macOS comes next
capture.waitingLiveView: Waiting for the camera's live view…
capture.sessionNote: Photos go to a temporary tab until you save them
capture.apertureHint: Set the aperture on the camera or lens
capture.formatHint: The camera may keep the old format for one more shot
capture.sessionBanner_one: This shot is in a temporary folder. Save it to keep it with your photos.
capture.sessionBanner_other: These {{count}} shots are in a temporary folder. Save them to keep them with your photos.
capture.discardTitle: Keep the shots of this session?
capture.discardBody_one: This shot is only in Fotollection's temporary folder. Save it to a folder of yours, or delete it.
capture.discardBody_other: These {{count}} shots are only in Fotollection's temporary folder. Save them to a folder of yours, or delete them.
capture.quitTitle: Keep the camera shots before closing?
capture.quitBody_one: Fotollection is closing, and one shot is still only in its temporary folder. Save it to a folder of yours, or delete it.
capture.quitBody_other: Fotollection is closing, and {{count}} shots are still only in its temporary folder. Save them to a folder of yours, or delete them.

places.title: Places
places.hint: The place printed on your photos. Type another name, like “Prague” for “Praha 1” or “Grandma’s”, and every stamp and frame follows.
places.noMatch: No town or city by that name
places.dialogBody: For scans and photos without a date or GPS. Fill in only what you want to change; Undo takes it back.
places.cameraDateNote: The time the camera wrote will be used again.
places.ownPlace: Back to the photo’s own GPS
places.ownPlaceNote: The place from the photo’s GPS will be used again, if it has one.
places.borrowBody: A camera without GPS gets the place of a phone photo of the same scene, taken close in time. Sure matches are filled in at once; Undo takes them back.
places.borrowNone: No photo of the same scene with GPS was found.
places.borrowReview: These look like the same scene, but less surely. Untick the ones that are not:
places.dialogTitleOne: Date and place of this photo

mode.label: Mode
mode.simpleHint: One photo at a time: ↑ keep, ↓ drop, then export
mode.collageHint: Two photos on one print, like a half-frame camera
mode.professionalHint: Every control: crop, frame, stamp styles, filters and best shot

simple.title: Simple
simple.doneHint_one: {{kept}} photo is in the print basket. Export it from the panel on the right.
simple.doneHint_other: {{kept}} photos are in the print basket. Export them from the panel on the right.
simple.exportHint_one: Export sends the {{count}} photo you kept (the print basket).
simple.exportHint_other: Export sends the {{count}} photos you kept (the print basket).

collage.autoTurnHint: Turn the photos so each lies like its half: no standing photo next to a lying one, for prints you cut in two. Undo with Cmd/Ctrl+Z
collage.revertTurnsHint: Bring every photo back to its own orientation on the sheets
collage.title: Collage
collage.turnHint: Turn the sheet the other way (R)
collage.rotatePhotoHint: Turn this photo a quarter in its half, on this sheet only (⇧R)
collage.pickToRotate: Choose a photo on the sheet to rotate it
collage.sheetSizeHint: Each sheet holds two photos, side by side or one above the other; it turns to suit its first photo.
collage.cutLineHint: A thin line between the photos, to cut the print in two.
collage.togetherHint: No line between the photos; the white between them stays.
collage.adviceBorder: Area {{area}}, photo {{photo}} inside the border · {{dpi}} DPI, {{quality}}
collage.empty: No photos to put on sheets
collage.emptyHint: Open a folder, or choose the print basket in the sidebar: its photos are paired in order, two to a sheet.
collage.keysHint: Drag a photo onto another to swap them · ← → choose · ⌥ ← → move · Enter or double-click to preview · R turn

ratioHints.photo: Each photo keeps its own ratio

collage.originalNote: A sheet needs a fixed size: Original is not used here, so sheets are 10 × 15. Choose a size above.
collage.pickToCrop: Click a photo on the sheet to crop it
collage.fillHint: No white: the two photos meet edge to edge, each filling its half. Crop each one to choose what it keeps.
collage.marginHint: A white margin stays round each photo; choose its ratio and size below.
collage.sheetPixelsHint: The two photos make one picture of this size, as sharp as the less sharp of them, so neither is enlarged.
collage.sheetKeys:
← →  other sheets · ↑ print basket · ↓ set aside
1 2  pick a photo · 0  the whole sheet · Esc  let go, then close
C  crop the picked photo · R  turn the sheet · ⇧R  turn the picked photo
{{mod}} + −  zoom · J  clipping · W  white balance from a grey point
E  the Edit tab

facts.gainMap: Lens shading map not applied yet

reuse.blankTicked_one: {{count}} ticked postcard has no address yet.
reuse.blankTicked_other: {{count}} ticked postcards have no address yet.
reuse.done_one: Used for {{count}} postcard · Cmd/Ctrl+Z undoes it
reuse.done_other: Used for {{count}} postcards · Cmd/Ctrl+Z undoes it
reuse.differAll_one: {{count}} other postcard has its own address.
reuse.differAll_other: {{count}} other postcards have their own address.
reuse.differTicked_one: {{count}} ticked postcard has its own address.
reuse.differTicked_other: {{count}} ticked postcards have their own address.

postcard.cutHint: Not all of it fits its lines and the rest is left off the print: shorten it, or choose a smaller size.
postcard.title: Postcard
postcard.hint: Each sheet becomes a postcard: one photo, and on the other half a stamp box and lines for a message or an address.
postcard.landscapeHint: The photo on the left, the card on the right
postcard.portraitHint: The card on top, the photo below
postcard.pens: Writing by hand on photo paper: use a fine permanent marker (Sharpie Ultra Fine, edding 400, Stabilo OHPen S). Try it in the stamp box first and let it dry for a minute; ballpoint and gel pens smear or skip on the coating. Or type the text in the postcard's preview.
postcard.sheetSizeHint: Each sheet holds one photo and a postcard back, held the way the Postcard card says.
postcard.cardHint: One photo and a postcard back on each print
postcard.pickToType: Choose a postcard to type its text.
postcard.messagePlaceholder: A few words… or nothing, to write by hand
postcard.addressPlaceholder:
Name
Street and number
Postcode, town, country

look.applyToAll: Apply this look to all photos
look.beforeHint: The photo without its colour, and back (\)

hints.brightness: The midtones lighter or darker; black and white stay.
hints.contrast: More or less difference between light and dark.
hints.highlights: The bright parts: bring back a sky, or brighten it.
hints.shadows: The dark parts: open them up, or deepen them.
hints.saturation: Every colour stronger, or towards grey.
hints.vibrance: Dull colours stronger first; skin is spared.
hints.shadowTint: A colour over the dark parts, as a film look.
hints.highlightTint: A colour over the bright parts.
hints.balance: Where the shadows end and the highlights begin.
hints.mono: Black and white through a colour filter, as on film: red darkens a blue sky the most.
hints.amount: How much of the whole look: every slider and its LUT together
hints.lutStrength: How much of the imported LUT, before the sliders

look.saveAsBody: Keep this photo's look under a name, to use it on other photos.
look.name: Name
look.sheetWhole: With no photo picked, the colour goes to both photos of the sheet.
look.sheetDiffers: The two photos have different colours: a change here gives both the same one.
look.vlogWarning: This LUT is made for V-Log video: on a photo it comes out far too strong. Lower its strength, or choose the matching photo LUT.
look.presetsEmpty: Your looks, LUTs and presets show here: save the photo's look, or import a LUT.
look.add: Add a look, a preset or a LUT
look.renameBody: The name this look is listed under.
look.moveBody: The group Presets & LUTs lists it under; empty for your own looks.
look.importFormats: Presets: Lightroom .xmp, .lrtemplate or a .zip of them. LUTs: .cube (1D or 3D up to 65 points) or HaldCLUT .png, at most 8 MB.
look.applyPreviewOn: On the photo picked in the grid
look.applyPick: Pick a look, LUT or preset below, then give it to the ticked photos or to every photo shown.
look.applyAskTitle_one: {{n}} photo has a colour of its own
look.applyAskTitle_other: {{n}} photos have a colour of their own
look.applyAskBody: Give {{name}} to them too, or keep their colour and give it only to the others? Crops, date stamps and RAW settings stay either way.
look.resetTicked_one: Back to the original colour: {{n}} ticked photo
look.resetTicked_other: Back to the original colour: {{n}} ticked photos
look.resetShown_one: Back to the original colour: {{n}} photo
look.resetShown_other: Back to the original colour: {{n}} photos
look.resetAskTitle_one: Bring {{n}} photo back to its original colour?
look.resetAskTitle_other: Bring {{n}} photos back to their original colour?
look.resetAskBody: Their look, LUT and colour sliders are taken away; crops, date stamps and RAW settings stay. ⌘Z brings the colour back.
look.resetDone_one: {{n}} photo back to its original colour. ⌘Z undoes it.
look.resetDone_other: {{n}} photos back to their original colour. ⌘Z undoes it.

hints.hue: Turns this colour toward its neighbours on the colour wheel.
hints.sat: Makes this colour stronger or greyer; other colours stay.
hints.lum: Makes this colour lighter or darker; greys stay.

rawLook.title: RAW colour
rawLook.neutralHint: The sensor's colours with the camera's exposure and a gentle curve: a calm starting point for your own look.
rawLook.cameraHint: Fitted to the JPEG the camera made inside the file: its contrast and colours, as on the camera's screen.

settingsWindow.title: Settings
settingsWindow.open: Settings: language, memory and cache, updates
settingsWindow.footer: These settings belong to this computer; projects never carry them.

about.general: The language and the look of the app
about.export: Where exports go, their quality, and whether to ask first
about.memory: How much RAM and disk Fotollection uses to open photos at once
about.updates: A newer version, when you ask
about.manual: The whole user guide, readable with no internet
about.report: Tell the author what went wrong
about.whatsNew: Every version and what it brought

settingsWindow.previewLayoutHint: Filling the window adds the Navigator and History on the left. F switches in the preview.

memory.title: RAM for previews
memory.hint: More RAM keeps more photos ready, so → ← and photos opened again show at once; less leaves more room for other apps. When the computer runs short of RAM, the previews give theirs back by themselves.
memory.now: Now: {{percent}} % of RAM, a {{limit}} GB cache, previews {{previews}}.
memory.defaultHint: 25 % of RAM, a 5 GB cache, previews prepared
memory.autoHint: Chooses for this computer's RAM and free disk
memory.autoExplain: Auto gives 40 % of RAM from 32 GB, 25 % from 12 GB and 15 % below; the largest cache that fits in a tenth of the free disk; and prepares previews unless less than 5 GB is free.

history.title: History
history.empty: No changes to this photo yet.
history.caption: Line under the date

compare.line: Drag to move the line between before and after

exportDialog.title: Export
exportDialog.qualityHint: JPEG quality: higher keeps more detail and makes larger files. 90 prints with no visible loss at a third of the size of 100.
exportDialog.filePrint: JPEG with full colour detail (4:4:4), the photo's own colour profile kept.
exportDialog.fileShare: JPEG in sRGB (4:2:0), as the platforms show it.
exportDialog.sizePrint: Each photo at the print size and crop chosen in the panel, at full resolution.
exportDialog.askEveryTimeHint: Show the export dialog each time Export is pressed. Off: export at once with these choices.
exportDialog.dontAskHint: Export at once with these choices next time; change them in Settings → Export.
exportDialog.subfolderHint: Inside the chosen folder, before the day folders.
exportDialog.existing: If a file of that name is there
exportDialog.replaceWarning: The old file is replaced and cannot be brought back.
exportDialog.limitHint: Each file at the chosen quality if it fits, else at the highest quality that does (not below 60).

metadataHint.camera: Camera, lens, exposure and capture date. The GPS position is always removed.
metadataHint.dateOnly: Only the capture date. The GPS position is always removed.
metadataHint.nothing: No details at all; the files keep only their colour profile.

develop.title: Settings
develop.copyBody: Choose what to take from this photo. Paste gives it to another photo, or to every ticked one.
develop.copyHint: The crop takes its straightening with it, the stamp its line.
develop.copyCollageHint: On a sheet the crop is the photo's collage crop; the stamp takes its line with it.
develop.pasteNothing: Copy settings from a photo first
develop.resetHint: Back to the shared settings: no look, crop or stamp of its own ({{keys}})

histogram.title: Histogram
histogram.label: Histogram of the photo: red, green and blue, and the light as a line
histogram.clippingHint: Marks on the photo what is blown (red) and blocked (black detail lost, blue), as Lightroom's J does.
histogram.pick: White balance from a grey spot (W)
histogram.pickHint: Then click something in the photo that should be neutral grey: warmth and tint follow, as one step.
histogram.pickNow: Click something grey in the photo · Esc cancels

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.againHint: The five pages of the basics, as on the first launch.

welcome.title: Open your photos
welcome.text: Open a folder of photos from a trip, or drop one on the window. Fotollection works on them where they are: nothing is copied, moved or uploaded.
welcome.alt: The gallery of a trip's photos

modes.title: Three modes
modes.text: Simple to keep or drop and print at once, Collage for two photos to a print or postcards, Pro for stars, best shots, crop and colour. Cmd/Ctrl+1, 2 and 3 switch between them.

choose.title: Choose the best
choose.text: Find best shots groups the bursts and keeps the best of each in the Workspace; the others go to Set aside, ready to come back. Press ↑ to put a photo in the print basket.

develop.title: Make it yours
develop.text: Open a photo to set its colour, crop it to the print size and stamp the date and town as film cameras did; the info frame adds the camera and lens.

print.title: Print
print.text: Export writes the photos at the shop's sizes, ready for a self-service kiosk or an online lab. Settings → Export keeps your choices for next time.

motion.label: Motion
motion.systemHint: Moves as the system's Reduce motion setting says.
motion.reduceHint: Slides and zooms become short fades.
